user_query: Under which conditions does node2vec avoid any bias from sample reuse while still improving efficiency?
llm_response: node2vec avoids bias from sample reuse when the reused samples are generated by an unbiased random-walk process, so that reusing them does not change the underlying sampling distribution. In that setting, it can still improve efficiency by caching or reusing walk-based training examples instead of regenerating them repeatedly, reducing computation while preserving the same expected objective.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This answer reflects the general idea behind unbiased reuse of random-walk samples in node2vec-style training, but the exact wording of the condition depends on the specific implementation and paper context.
